subject: MPA flag: close-signal derisk capture & revised timeline
messages:
From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@acmehealth.com>, acme-legal <contracts@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: initial MPA and evaluation timeline

Marissa — thanks for the run-through this morning. We like the MAP outline but a couple of constraints from our side: 1) Procurement has a monthly cutover; if we don’t have signed SOW by May 14 we push to the June procurement window, and 2) our security team needs the SOC2 evidence and a short list of PKI/KMS integrations before the eval kickoff.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can commit to the SOC2 artifacts (or a timeboxed window) and whether the eval plan can be compressed to a three-week focused run (rather than 5 weeks) if we scope to a single pilot scope?

—Tom
Director, Digital Transformation
Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: initial MPA and evaluation timeline

Tom — thanks for the clarity. Short answers up front: yes on providing SOC2 artifacts (we can deliver extract logs and report package by 2027-05-04) and yes we can design a compressed 3-week pilot provided the scope is limited to: SSO/KMS integration, 100k monthly inference tokens, and three acceptance prompts.

I’m attaching a tightened MPA draft and a compressed eval runbook for your review (MPA_v3_20270420.xlsx; EvalPlan_Runbook_v2.pdf). If procurement needs signatures by May 14 we should aim to have commercial redlines resolved by May 7. Can we do an internal redline pass this week? If needed I’ll escalate to Karthik for a credit/term decision.

Action items: 
- Tom / Sara: confirm pilot scope by EOD 2027-04-22
- Acme Legal: share redlines by 2027-04-28 (or we escalate)
- Redwood: deliver SOC2 artifact snapshot by 2027-05-04

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachments: MPA_v3_20270420.xlsx (spreadsheet), EvalPlan_Runbook_v2.pdf (PDF)

From: Sara Li <sara.li@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: acme-legal <contracts@acmehealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: initial MPA and evaluation timeline

Marissa / Tom — confirming scope: Acme will accept the compressed pilot scope you outlined (SSO/KMS + 100k tokens + 3 prompts). Procurement asked for the contract redline window — legal will try to return comments by 2027-04-28 but requests a hard escalation to vendor management if we don’t have a response by then.

One note: our security team asked whether Redwood can support a time-limited dedicated environment for the eval (data isolation) — this will reduce barriers but needs a cost estimate. Please confirm a ballpark delta for a short-lived dedicated pool for the three-week pilot.

Best,
Sara
Program Manager, Digital Initiatives

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MPA_v3: pricing delta for short-lived dedicated evaluation environment

On Tue, Apr 22, 2027 at 08:37 AM Sara Li <sara.li@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> Marissa / Tom — confirming scope: Acme will accept the compressed pilot scope you outlined...

Quick internal note for escalation if we need it: we can provision a 3-week dedicated pool on a Standard Dedicated node set. Ballpark delta: $6k–$9k for the three weeks depending on peak concurrency. If procurement signals they need guaranteed isolation to move forward this amount is defensible; otherwise we recommend using a hosted instance with prefix/KV isolation to keep costs lower.

Neha — can you prepare a short risk log entry and a fallback play if legal returns late? We should capture: procurement window (May 14 cutoff), escalation trigger (no redlines by 04-28), credit/term authority (Karthik), and SOC2 delivery commitment (05-04). I’ll add the pricing delta to the MPA spreadsheet.

—Jonas
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
Attachment stub: redline_contract_ACME_v1.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@acmehealth.com>, Sara Li <sara.li@acmehealth.com>
Cc: acme-legal <contracts@acmehealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: procurement window approaching — MAP escalation & risk capture

Tom / Sara — quick escalation update as procurement cutover is this Friday (May 14 in their cadence). Summary and asks: 

Summary:
- Acme confirmed compressed pilot scope on 2027-04-22.
- Acme Legal has not returned redlines as of today (we have their acknowledgement).
- Redwood will deliver SOC2 artifact snapshot by 2027-05-04 (confirmed).
- Pricing delta for a 3-week dedicated evaluation pool: $6k–$9k (Jonas).

Risk log (short):
1) Procurement slip: if redlines not in by 2027-04-28, procurement may miss the May 14 cutover and push to June. Impact: go-live delayed ~4 weeks. Mitigation: Escalate to vendor management + offer short-term credit to bridge procurement if legal delay is the only blocker. Owner: Karthik Iyer.
2) Security artifact timing: SOC2 snapshot due 2027-05-04. If delayed, we’ll offer a shallow security workshop and temporary logging/export access to satisfy their assessment team. Owner: Neha Kapoor.
3) Cost shock for dedicated eval: Acme to confirm whether they want isolation; default to hosted to avoid delta. Owner: Jonas Weber.

Immediate asks (today):
- Acme Legal: please return redlines by COB 2027-04-28 or confirm a single redline priority list we can negotiate.
- Tom / Sara: confirm whether you need the dedicated pool (yes/no) so we can finalize MPA costs.
- Karthik: please confirm approval authority for up to $10k short-term credit (if we decide to bridge procurement).

If I don’t hear back by EOD 2027-04-30 I will escalate to vendor management and propose the short credit as a one-time exec exception. We want to preserve the May procurement cutover.

Thanks — Marissa
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (650) 555-0123
Attachments: MP A_v3_20270420.xlsx (updated pricing tab), EvalPlan_Runbook_v2.pdf (compressed runbook)

From: acme-legal <contracts@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@acmehealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: procurement window approaching — MAP escalation & risk capture

Marissa — thanks for the summary and the patience. We are finalizing the redlines; the delay was internal (resource reallocation). We will return a prioritized redline set by 2027-05-02 (two business days later than your requested window). If Redwood can provide the SOC2 snapshot on 2027-05-04 as promised, procurement will accept a late redline return and still attempt to queue for May 14 — not guaranteed.

We prefer the hosted isolation approach unless Redwood provides a firm pricing guarantee for the dedicated pool. Please hold escalation for now; we will update on 2027-05-02.

—Acme Legal
Vendor Management & Contracts
